02

THE CREW BEHIND THE CAUSE

A shared compass.

The Eco-Social Club (ESC) of Silicon University, Odisha is a student-led initiative committed to advancing environmental sustainability, social responsibility and individual well-being. Guided by the principles of collective action and responsible engagement, the club works towards addressing contemporary environmental and societal challenges through awareness campaigns, outreach programmes and impactful initiatives.ESC is Silicon University, Odisha’s student-led Eco-Social Club. We bring environmental care, social responsibility and well-being into action through awareness, outreach and community initiatives.

03

ECOLOGY · SOCIAL WELFARE · ZEAL

Three paths. One purpose.

Operating across three core domains, Ecology, Social Welfare and Zeal, ESC provides a platform for students to translate ideas into meaningful action. Through diverse initiatives, collaborative engagements and community-oriented programmes, the club promotes environmental consciousness, social development and holistic well-being. Its flagship annual event, URVION, has emerged as a prominent platform for sustainability-driven activities and innovation, attracting over 400 participants. Building on this success, URVION 2.0, themed “The Pirates of Carebian,” aims to further expand opportunities for innovation, collaboration and collective impact.Ecology. Social Welfare. Zeal. Our three domains turn student ideas into action. Following URVION’s 400+ participants, URVION 2.0 — “The Pirates of Carebian” — opens new opportunities for innovation and collaboration.

04

OUR NEXT HORIZON

A growing force for good.

With a growing community of 500+ registered members and outreach extending beyond its immediate membership, ESC continues to strengthen its presence through meaningful initiatives and strategic collaborations. The club aspires to cultivate socially conscious, environmentally responsible and proactive individuals who contribute towards a healthier, more inclusive and sustainable future.With 500+ registered members, ESC connects students and communities through meaningful initiatives. Together, we work towards a healthier, more inclusive and sustainable future.
